Definition: from (the feminine form of) G2288 and G5342; death-bearing, i.e. fatal:--deadly.
BiblicalUsage: The word thanatḗphoros carries the sense of deadly. In James 3:8, full of deadly poison. In the Greek text the word is spelled θανατηφόρος.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a tongue full of deadly poison is a sober warning, and I guard my own words because of it.
